# BPMN Desk 0.7.3

- Mark diagrams without a file with a gray tab dot; edits turn it blue, and Undo restores the initial state. New diagrams, duplicates and monitor copies all ask for confirmation before closing.
- Give duplicates their own starting state, including copied XML drafts, and preserve change indicators when restoring a session.
- Fix a leftover XML draft after undoing all XML edits that could block saving later diagram changes.
- Include unfinished property input when saving, duplicating, reloading or closing. Tab tooltips now describe diagram and file states consistently in English and Russian.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are available. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
